text:
Elena Morales: dropping a quick patch idea: add a "schema peek" micro-interaction inline in the runline so developers can glance at function outputs without expanding full callstack. mock: https://figma.com/file/fake/schema-peek
Noah Becker: neat. does peek show formatted JSON or a key-value digest? concern: big payloads will blow the peek size.
Tasha Nguyen: suggest digest: show top 3 keys with small badges, and an ellipsis when more. include a "view raw" button inside peek for power users.
Elena Morales: yes, digest by default. also propose making the peek an overlay panel that doesn't reflow the list so users keep context while scanning.
A11y-bot: accessibility checklist: peek must be focusable (tabindex=0), announce role=dialog when opened, and trap focus inside until closed. avoid hover-only triggers. provide aria-label like "Open schema peek for this run".
Noah Becker: what about keyboard shortcuts? maybe "k" to open peek when runline focused. but ensure no conflict with global shortcuts.
Tasha Nguyen: I like shortcut but optional. main ask: focus order — peek open should be next after runline, not jump to bottom of page.
Design-bot: color/contrast note: peek background should be slightly elevated white with border #E6E7EB. badges use muted indigo 500 for labels, counts in 600. keep motion subtle.
Elena Morales: microcopy debate: label the control "Schema peek" vs "Peek schema" vs "Quick view". Which reads best?
Noah Becker: "Quick view" is generic, may confuse with other previews. "Schema peek" is explicit but a bit developer-y. "Peek schema" reads like an action.
Tasha Nguyen: prefer action-style: "Peek schema" (verb first) because buttons should be actions. show secondary tooltip text: "Press Enter to open schema peek" for keyboard users.
A11y-bot: tooltip must be accessible; use aria-describedby and ensure it disappears on focus. NVDA users prefer explicit button labels over tooltips. include visible helper text on hover/focus for small screens.
Noah Becker: run history layout: collapsed row should display micro-timestamp, assistant snippet (first 3 tokens), and a compact call-count badge like "1 call". when expanded show full callstack with peer timings.
Elena Morales: agreed. also thought: when a tool call errors, peek should show a prominent inline hint "Tool error: click for details" with aria-live=assertive so screen reader users are notified.
Tasha Nguyen: UX micro-interaction: when peek is opened from keyboard, focus the first actionable in the peek (usually "view raw"), and hitting ESC closes and returns focus to the peek trigger. add a small animation 90ms fade+scale for clarity.
Design-bot: PR created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/playground/pull/8123 by Elena Morales with CSS tokens and behavior tests.
Noah Becker: I'll add e2e test for keyboard flow and a11y assertions. also lock the copy to "Peek schema" in PR description.
A11y-bot: reminder: include a screen-reader narration sample in PR and keyboard-only screenshots.
Tasha Nguyen: will run a quick 3-person usability check on Thursday to validate discoverability and the "Peek schema" label.
Elena Morales: thanks all, I'll iterate on the Figma with the button-first copy and post an updated deploy preview later today. :sparkles:
